citation.authors: Baeten JM, Donnell D, Ndase P, Mugo NR et al

record.population: 4,758 heterosexual HIV-serodiscordant couples in Kenya and Uganda; the HIV-negative partner (62% male) took tenofovir, tenofovir-emtricitabine or placebo
record.design: Randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial (Partners PrEP), follow-up up to 36 months
record.finding: Of 82 HIV infections in the HIV-negative partners, 17 were in the tenofovir group (0.65 per 100 person-years), 13 in the tenofovir-emtricitabine group (0.50) and 52 in the placebo group (1.99). That is a 67% reduction with tenofovir (95% CI 44 to 81) and 75% with the combination (95% CI 55 to 87).
record.note: East African couples; the abstract was cut off before the adherence analysis, so the effect of taking every dose is not stated here.
